title: Only draw when something happens
description:
A standalone tool should not redraw an unchanged screen hundreds of times a second. Write the logic that decides, each time round the loop, whether to draw a frame or to sleep until the next input:

```cpp
class IdleTracker
{
public:
    explicit IdleTracker(int settleFrames);   // extra frames to draw after the last input
    void onInput();                           // some input arrived
    void setAnimating(bool animating);        // something on screen moves (a spinner, a live graph)
    bool shouldDraw();                        // called once per loop iteration
};
```

- `shouldDraw` returns `true` while animating, every time.
- Otherwise, after `onInput`, it returns `true` for the next `settleFrames` calls (ImGui sometimes needs a frame or two to settle a layout), then `false` until the next input.
- At the very start (before any input) it returns `true` for `settleFrames` calls too, so the first screen is drawn.
- Input while frames are still pending starts the count again from `settleFrames`.
lessonTitle: The Frame and the Draw Data
